finding.summary: Non-expiring sessions leave no time-based limit on stolen-session access

claims.text: PRD.md explicitly requires sessions to never expire. This removes time-based termination of a stolen session, allowing continued access unless another mechanism invalidates it; the PRD specifies no such mechanism.

recommendations: Require server-enforced idle and absolute session expiration, and define session revocation on logout, password reset, and suspected compromise.
